title: Lipschitz Bandits with Arbitrary Feedback Delays
abstract: arXiv:2608.15036v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Lipschitz bandit problem extends the traditional multi-armed bandit framework to continuous action spaces by assuming that the reward functions satisfy a Lipschitz condition. This work investigates Lipschitz bandits under arbitrary feedback delays, where reward signals are not received immediately upon taking an action but after an arbitrarily chosen delay. We consider both stochastic and adversarial reward settings, proposing an elimination-based algorithm and an EXP3-based algorithm, respectively. For both settings, our algorithms achieve a regret bound of $\tilde{O}\left(T^{\frac{d_z+1}{d_z+2}}+\sqrt{D}\right)$ over a time horizon $T$ with total delay $D$, where the main difference between settings lies in the definition of the zooming dimension $d_z$. Our bounds match existing delay-free regret guarantees for Lipschitz bandits and characterize the additional $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{D})$ impact introduced by feedback delays.

translated_title: 具有任意反馈延迟的Lipschitz Bandits问题
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15036v1 公告类型：新 摘要：Lipschitz bandit问题通过假设奖励函数满足Lipschitz条件，将传统的多臂老虎机框架扩展到连续动作空间。本研究探讨了在任意反馈延迟下的Lipschitz bandits，其中奖励信号并非在采取行动后立即收到，而是在任意选择的延迟后到达。我们考虑了随机和对抗性奖励设置，分别提出了基于消除的算法和基于EXP3的算法。对于两种设置，我们的算法在时间范围$T$和总延迟$D$下，实现了$\tilde{O}\left(T^{\frac{d_z+1}{d_z+2}}+\sqrt{D}\right)$的遗憾界，其中两种设置之间的主要区别在于缩放维度$d_z$的定义。我们的界与现有的无延迟Lipschitz bandits遗憾保证相匹配，并刻画了反馈延迟引入的额外$\tilde{O}(\sqrt{D})$影响。
tldr: 本文首次研究了任意反馈延迟下的Lipschitz bandits问题，提出了针对随机和对抗性设置的算法，并实现了与无延迟情况匹配的遗憾界，额外延迟影响仅为$\tilde{O}(\sqrt{D})$。
en_tdlr: This paper is the first to study Lipschitz bandits with arbitrary feedback delays, proposing algorithms for both stochastic and adversarial settings that achieve regret bounds matching delay-free guarantees, with an additional $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{D})$ impact from delays.
